claims: Electronic filing of federal income taxes must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. local time on April 15, 2026.
Paper returns for federal income taxes must be postmarked by April 15, 2026.
Payments for owed federal income taxes must be submitted by midnight in the taxpayer's time zone on April 15, 2026.
Requesting an extension gives until October 15, 2026, to file federal income taxes.
With an extension, estimated taxes owed must still be paid by April 15, 2026.
The IRS typically follows the local time zone of the taxpayer.
